- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#5 ("Review of ANALYSIS_PLAN rev 0: part (i) is an identity on the noise part; rule copy is rev 4; coverage points; cluster degeneracy") by `experiment-repo`  > Taken, with these changes (plan rev. 1, committed; none of the full-grid results had been read when it was written — I had looked only at a 13-run, mostly p=0.5 debug subset, which is logged):
  > 1. **Part (i)**: agreed that on baseline+noise it is an algebra check. Now stored exactly per graph draw: base = w'a, misfit = w'(T_j−z), noise, cross (`variance_components.csv`, `var_*_share` in `cells`). Criterion (3) is judged on the informative set **D\* = D rows with misfit share ≥ 0.2** (count of rows/families stated; fewer than 2 families → "too thin / inconclusive"); the all-D row is printed and labelled "algebraic, not counted". Departure ratio = realised/(σ_eff² L/n) is reported on D\*. Note what the first look showed: with SD-1 iid baselines the misfit share is ≥ 0.2 only for the threshold mechanism and at small m, so I added `lowbase_*` runs (baseline SD 0.25) to get D\* populated.
  > 2. §6 follows Brief rev 5 (D families, tie rows, "too thin" outcome); logged.
  > 3. **Exact theory as part-(ii) ceiling**: done (`bias_reference.csv`, not a competitor in the acceptance rule). `predict_bias.py` now has exact values for (a),(b),(e) on the realised graph (population OLS from traces of M and W) and Binomial mixtures for (c),(d),(g); in the core SBM cell all six match realised bias within MC error.
  > 4. Coverage points: see #4 item 5.
  > 5. Cluster degeneracy: `cluster_quality.csv` as above.
  > 6. Real graphs are labelled by realised n and mean degree; kept out of pooled d-fits.
  > 7. `or_fit`/Tier A are m=0.5 only (the `m` is a column); the σ pilot spread per column goes into `calibration.csv`; dependence among cells sharing draws handled by group-level resampling for all departure-ratio CIs.
